claude.result:
Perfect! I've successfully implemented the feature for frai-gate. Here's what I've done:

## Implementation Summary

### 1. Added `renderSummary` function to `src/gate/report.ts`
- Exports the function for public use
- Formats output as `<VERDICT> <answered>/<total>` where total is 7
- Returns `BLOCK 0/7: structure` when the gate section is missing
- Lists block-severity check IDs in GATE_CHECKS order when there are issues
- Properly counts answered checks (warnings don't reduce the count)

### 2. Added `--summary` flag to CLI
- Updated `frai-gate check` command to support `--summary` flag
- Outputs only the summary line instead of the full report
- Exit codes remain unchanged (1 = BLOCK, 0 = PASS/WARN)
- `--json` flag takes priority if both are specified

### 3. Documentation
- Updated HELP text to document the `--summary` flag with an example: `"BLOCK 5/7: evaluation, transparency"`

### 4. Comprehensive Tests
- Created `src/gate/report.test.ts` with 8 test cases covering:
  - PASS verdict (all checks answered)
  - WARN verdict (warnings only)
  - BLOCK verdict (missing gate section)
  - Single and multiple block findings
  - Proper ordering of check IDs
  - Deduplication of multiple findings for the same check

### Verification
✅ Build: `pnpm --filter frai-gate build` — Success  
✅ Tests: `pnpm --filter frai-gate test` — 19 tests passing (8 new + 11 existing)

The feature is ready for use!
